messages:
maria: FYI — Datadog asked for an explicit checklist we can share with customers before the joint announcement. They want legal + technical items spelled out (data flow, retention, PII handling, and dashboard access model). Can engineering + legal confirm items we can publish?

alex: tagging in eng. from runtime POV main points: OTLP ingest, sampling defaults, sensitive-field redaction, and a billing/ingest cap for marketplace customers. Also need a short config example.

jordan: from partnerships: marketing wants to include a pre-built dashboard tile and a short one-pager we can co-brand. They also asked if Datadog wants to run a joint webinar week of the launch.

paul: legal quick note — we can provide a high-level checklist but no contractual terms. For Marketplace tile we need to ensure we don't surface any customer PII in screenshots. Also need to confirm DPA + data processing locations (EU/US). I'll send redline guidance.

anya: ops/infra: we do have an internal OTLP -> Datadog exporter path but it currently includes full labels. We should add a sanitization step before export. Proposing a light pipeline: drop fields matching regex for emails and ssn, and hash any user_id fields.

samir: security: please ensure the exporter uses per-tenant API keys stored in KMS. No shared global key. Also enforce TLS and mTLS to Datadog intake endpoints.

maria: great. Alex, can you paste the minimal OTLP config we should recommend? marketing wants to show it in the docs. Keep it short.

alex: sure — quick sample we can show (YAML):
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  batch: {}
  resource/attributes:
    actions:
      - key: user.email
        action: delete
      - key: user.id
        action: hash
exporters:
  datadog:
    api_key: ${DATADOG_API_KEY}  # per-tenant, store in KMS
    site: datadoghq.com
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch, resource/attributes]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

jordan: perfect. Can we also provide a small screenshot-ready dashboard config (a short JSON or list of widgets) so Datadog can populate the tile? Marketing prefers something we can drop in with 3 panels: latency p50/p95, token-throughput, and model-fallback-rate.

anya: I can export a sample dashboard json — will anonymize IDs. One ask: we should document the metric names exactly (redwood.request.latency_p95, redwood.token.count, redwood.model.fallback_rate).

paul: from compliance angle: add a checkbox to the checklist: "No customer PII in dashboard samples" and "Confirm data residency region". Also include requirement: "Audit logs for Data Exports available for 365 days" — Datadog wanted that visible.

maria: OK action list so we have clear owners: 1) Alex — produce sanitized OTLP snippet + doc blurb (due EOD Wed). 2) Anya — dashboard JSON + metric name list (due Thu). 3) Paul — DPA/DPA talking points + checklist items (due Thu). 4) Samir — KMS/API key ops doc + mTLS notes (due Fri). 5) Jordan — coordinate co-marketing ask and webinar proposal with Datadog (due Mon).

alex: I started a small PR branch for the exporter sanitizer, will link once it's up. ETA tomorrow morning.

sre-bot: deploy: exporter-sanitizer v0.2 deployed to staging at 2026-03-19T14:12:03Z :rocket:

jordan: nice! once we have the sanitizer in staging we can ask Datadog for a quick smoke test with their ingestion team.

samir: one security nuance — hashing user.id is fine but we should document re-identification risk if correlated with other attributes. I'll add a short note to the ops doc.

maria: thanks all. I'll draft the public-friendly checklist copy and ping for reviews tomorrow. If anyone wants to add anything to the checklist now, drop it here.

paul: add: "Exported traces do not contain verbatim request bodies" — put in the checklist.

anya: also add sampling guidance: recommend 10% tail-sampling by default for traces with >2s latency to control costs in marketplace listings.

alex: noted. I'll include sampling example in the snippet.

maria: awesome. Closing loop: once PR + dashboard JSON + legal blurb exist we'll share to datadog-partner@ and schedule the webinar cadences. :thumbsup:
